findings.title: Doing as taking up custody
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the brothers' emphatic doing can be heard as an offer to assume a custodial function associated with the father, later expressed as guarding and formalized by covenant.
findings.mechanism: The adjacent father and action forms in the focus meet the later guarding claim in 12:63 and covenant in 12:66; the promise takes on a role-assimilation contour.
findings.reader_payoff: Their assurance can be heard not only as a plan to persuade but as a claim that they can carry the father's protective responsibility for the brother.
findings.containment: This is form-distant and exploratory; it supplements the ordinary action and persuasion reading and is not a lexical derivation of fa'ilun from fatherhood.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies the adjacent focus forms, guarding, covenant, and an explicit form-distance qualification; unresolved contextual branches remain attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: babalık, besleyip yetiştirme ve oluşuma ya da iyileşmeye kaynaklık etme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Birini ebeveynin çocuğunu beslediği gibi besleyip büyütme ve yetiştirme eylemidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The action participle is heard as taking up a care-and-upbringing function.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The adjacent father and later guarding claim supply the protective role.
branch_activations.activation: The focus action touches the fatherhood care facet through the stated offer to guard the brother.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: They present themselves as able to act in a role that relieves the father of direct custody.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a form-distant role resonance, not the ordinary lexical meaning of the action participle.

branch_activations.carrier: Their guarding claim specifies the protective function they offer to assume.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus places the offer beside the named father and the promised action.
branch_activations.activation: Guarding makes the abstract role-taking concrete enough to return to the focus promise.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their doing is colored as custodianship offered in answer to paternal concern.
branch_activations.boundary: No unprovided lexical gloss is assigned to the unresolved branch.

branch_activations.carrier: The confirmed covenant transfers offered care into accountable obligation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The guarding promise has already framed the action as custodial.
branch_activations.activation: The covenant gives the proposed protective role a binding form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The custodial offer is tested by a bond rather than left as a casual assurance.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed role does not establish that the brothers deserve or fulfill the custody.
